<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="sliding_door_cabinet">
  <material name="carcass_wood">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.36 0.20 1.0"/>
  </material>
  <material name="door_wood">
    <color rgba="0.72 0.52 0.30 1.0"/>
  </material>

  <!-- Cabinet carcass: 1.67 m wide, 0.41 m deep, 0.71 m tall.
       Frame origin is on the floor at the middle of the cabinet footprint.
       X = width, Y = toward the back (front faces -Y), Z = up. -->
  <link name="base_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.025 0.355" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="30.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="1.6805" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="8.2325" iyz="0.0"
               izz="7.3925"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.025 0.355" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.67 0.41 0.71"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="carcass_wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.025 0.355" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.67 0.41 0.71"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Left sliding door, on the inner (rear) track. -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.19283" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.53017" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.33767"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 0.68"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 0.68"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Right sliding door, on the outer (front) track. -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.19283" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.53017" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.33767"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 0.68"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 0.68"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Left door slides to the right (+X) to open. -->
  <joint name="door_left_joint" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.42 -0.19 0.355" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.85" effort="50.0" velocity="0.5"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Right door slides to the left (-X) to open. -->
  <joint name="door_right_joint" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="door_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.42 -0.22 0.355" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.85" upper="0.0" effort="50.0" velocity="0.5"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
